. Like other event maps, this map has a specialized wave structure with special enemies. Players started with a varying amount of cash, based on the difficulty chosen. It had no unique rewards other than the
, which can only be gotten every 24 hours from triumphs.

You only got cash if an enemy was killed, or in some cases, damaged by a specific amount of health. Additionally, the amount gained is a set amount of cash, which is not always equal to the enemy's health. Enemies split their cash between players, regardless of how much damage the player dealt to it. If, in a duo, one player did all the damage to an enemy, both players would receive 50% of the cash the enemy would normally give in solo. This means that in solo, you received 100% of the cash when an enemy is killed, or it was damaged enough. With each additional player, this is reduced to 50% in duo, 33% in trio and 25% in quad. If it is a decimal number, it got rounded up or down depending on the decimal value. If it was at least 0.5, it gets rounded up. If it was less than 0.5, it got rounded down.

takes place on a desolate corrupted area in the middle of nowhere. It is made out of purple Roblox parts with studs and purple binary on them. This area is surrounded by multiple pillars, which either have moving orange cogs on them or giant hands. Behind the entrance, there is also a large tower placed on nothing with a cog at the front of it.
The path starts and ends at a white portal. The map takes a short straight path which leads into two u-turns, ending with another short straight path that leads to the exit.

Each player was allowed to pick from one of three preset loadouts. Alongside these preset options, players could opt to use their current loadout as the first choice. However, if one's loadout contained no towers, this option would be unavailable.
